analyst_view.overall: Danny Buijs's Fortuna Sittard are sixth and unbeaten in six league games after a 1-1 draw at Feyenoord last weekend. A win would lift them above AZ into fifth, but they have taken only seven points from 15 at home. Henk Brugge's Telstar are near the bottom. They beat Utrecht 4-2 but then went out of the KNVB Beker to Almere City in midweek, and they are without Patrick Brouwer, Rui Mendes and Gerald Alders.

goals.text: The numbers say 3 goals. Fortuna have the lowest possession in the league and play a compact, counter-attacking game. Their unbeaten run includes several draws and narrow wins, including last week's 1-1 at Feyenoord. Telstar's away form is poor, and they are missing midfielder Patrick Brouwer and forward Rui Mendes, although Tyrone Owusu has been scoring.

corners.text: The numbers say about 10.7 corners. Fortuna's low-possession style may give Telstar more of the ball and a few extra corners, but nothing in the news moves the total clearly.

cards.text: The numbers say 2.6 cards, with Dennis Higler refereeing. We found no news of discipline problems or bad blood between these sides, so we stay with the model.

shots.text: The numbers say about 28 shots. Fortuna rarely have the ball and rely on a few clear chances rather than lots of attempts. Telstar played a cup tie in midweek and are short of attacking options without Mendes and Brouwer.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.3 shots on target, which is high. Fortuna are efficient but take relatively few shots, and Telstar have struggled to create away from home. A total just under 10 looks more realistic.
